title: Stalk exchange under compatible pointed strict localization
statement: Let Λ be a commutative coefficient ring, X′→P¹_S and X′→T a pullback square over g:T→S [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square, def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], and σ:Spec k→S, τ:Spec k′→T separably closed geometric points with ι:Spec k′→Spec k and ι≫σ=τ≫g [def-weil-geometric-point]. Choose an algebraically closed Ω and ν:Spec Ω→Spec k′. Let A,B be strictly henselian local rings [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] with eA:Spec A≅S_(νισ) and eB:Spec B≅T_(ντ) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Write jA=eA≫j_(νισ), jB=eB≫j_(ντ) [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Suppose φ:A→B is local and ρA:Spec k→Spec κA, ρB:Spec k′→Spec κB satisfy Spec φ≫jA=jB≫g, ρA≫rA≫jA=σ, ρB≫rB≫jB=τ and ρB≫Spec(κφ)=ι≫ρA, where rA,rB are closed-point maps. For any torsion Λ-module étale sheaf F on P¹_S [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf], set F0=(P¹(jA))^*F. For every q≥0 there are additive equivalences a1 and a2 from the source and target geometric stalks at τ of the original degree-q derived exchange to the corresponding closed-point stalks at Spec κB of the exchange over Spec φ. They satisfy a2(exchange_original(x))=exchange_local(a1(x)) for all x [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. No residue cohomology or closed-fibre comparison is part of the conclusion.

proof.text: Use properness of the projective-line projection for qcqs. The inverse-image stalk formula identifies the original source stalk with the stalk at σ. Extension to Ω leaves pointed neighbourhoods equivalent, since finite separable extensions split over k and k′. The canonical strict-henselization stalk formula and the pullback universal properties identify the two original stalks with cohomology over the total strict-local projective lines, and the same formula over A and B identifies the two local stalks with those groups. Compose to obtain a1 and a2.

For module coefficients compare via an injective module resolution and acyclicity of its underlying abelian sheaves. The Cech argument for this acyclicity applies at the universe of Λ; it does not assert that the forgetful functor preserves injectives. The existing encoding of injective module sheaves uses a coefficient ring in Type u, whereas this statement requires the same argument at Type (u+1), with the ModuleCat encoding. This coefficient-universe bridge is part of this intermediate, not supplied by the narrower existing Lean signature.

Choose compatible resolutions and use derivedExchangeTermwise. Both exchanges restrict sections along the same base-changed pointed neighbourhood. The structural and residue squares force φ to commute with pointed-neighbourhood projections, by uniqueness of pointed étale lifts from a strictly henselian local scheme. Thus the section maps agree on all representatives. Exact filtered colimits commute with homology and give the asserted equation. Transport from P¹_T to the arbitrary X′ along the unique pullback isomorphism.
